_comment: The campaign's wavefront configuration (crustify's specs/tools/wavefront), planner run 10, wavefront b3a737a.

closure: the configured build of build.json version 8 (the media-ingest profile): every compiled TU of libavutil, libswresample, libswscale, libavcodec, libavformat, libavfilter and fftools, with the internal headers and template .c files they include (impl_files), and the installed headers they include (api_headers). The C the libavutil pilot leaves out stays in the closure so that its layout uses, raw sites and references count.

modules: one record per module of crustify/artifacts/modules.json, named <link-unit>/<name>, ' (foundational)' after a foundational module's name; each file entry's items keep only the entities that file is home to.
schedule_seeds: what planner run 10 schedules, every libavutil file, less the deprecated items (av_assert0_fpu, avpriv_slicethread_create, avpriv_slicethread_execute).
